producer_report.summary: Added docs/design/jev-code-health.md (design only): five typed choice questions (one-thing, adds-coupling, module-placement, god-object-drift, duplicates-existing-logic). Each has state with an excerpt bound, options, criteria, numeric thresholds and effect. Also covers the record-only shadow period with exit rule, scoring from landing records (flagged file breaks or churns; split lands and churn drops, versus a deterministic baseline), fit with the planned deterministic check, Hestia (D129) and scope guard (D127), cost per landing (about 19 calls x $0.00001, estimate, cap 100), alternatives, risks, and a six-job build plan (J1-J6, each one producer run with files and a test). Appended proposed D130 to docs/decisions.md and added a CHANGELOG entry. cargo test --locked -q passes.
